title: More Than 10,000 ICE Officers Required to Receive Additional Training
detail: More than 10,000 ICE officers whose training was expedited during the hiring surge must now complete additional training. ICE reported over 48,000 arrests in September.

title: ICE Changes Vehicle Stop Policy After Deadly Incidents
detail: ICE announced vehicle stops must be conducted by trained officers using lights and sirens after deadly incidents in Texas, Maine and the Chicago area. An ICE spokesperson said the memo makes no changes to how stops are conducted.
